6.178 rsWrongNumberOfMatrixCells
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsWrongNumberOfMatrixCells is a critical error that will occur when a MatrixRow element contains a
different number of MatrixCell elements than the number of StaticColumn elements within a Matrix. If
the matrix contains no StaticColumn instances, each MatrixRow will contain exactly one MatrixCell
element.
